messages:
maria: Heads up — compliance asked for a single export that shows every routing policy change (who changed what, old/new, reason) across all orgs. They want NDJSON suitable for downstream SIEMs. :clipboard:
jin: Do they want diffs or full snapshots for each change? diffs are smaller but harder to reconstruct state. :thinking:
alex: For auditors we usually keep diffs with a redaction/PII flag and a link to the preserved full snapshot signed by KMS. avoids leaking creds. :lock:
sam: From the Console UX side, customers want an easy way to query "who changed route X between dates" and also to export to S3. Need timestamps + actor resolution (service account vs user) and human-readable reasons.
maria: Exactly. Also we need to include routing policy metadata: target model id, region routing, cost-tier, fallback rules. And important: stable policy ids so the exported diffs can be applied.
jin: Proposal: event shape = ndjson lines, each event: {"event_ts":"...","event_type":"policy.change","policy_id":"...","actor":"...","actor_type":"user|service","change_type":"create|update|delete","patch":"...","snapshot_url":"s3://..."} 
jin: Example line: ```{
  "event_ts": "2026-10-12T15:04:05Z",
  "event_type": "policy.change",
  "policy_id": "route-83f2",
  "actor": "maria",
  "actor_type": "user",
  "change_type": "update",
  "patch": [{"op":"replace","path":"/targets/0/region","from":"us-east-1","value":"eu-west-1"}],
  "reason": "spillover to eu during maintenance",
  "snapshot_url": "s3://redwood-audits/2026/10/12/route-83f2.snapshot.gpg"
}```
alex: A few constraints: 1) patch objects can leak PII if policies embed user identifiers. We need a redaction policy and a PII classification field. 2) Signing snapshots is good. 3) Access control: exports should only be available to org admins + compliance roles.
sam: For the Console export flow, do we need synchronous export OR async job with webhook? Large orgs will need async. And include pagination, time-range filters, actor filters.
maria: Async job + S3 destination + pre-signed URL for download. Also support streaming exports via newline-delimited JSON for SIEM ingestion (no presigned object needed).
jin: On API semantics: we debated returning the full event stream from /audit/events vs offering a dedicated /audit/exports endpoint that kicks off an export job with payload `{filter, redaction_mode, destination}`. I vote for export endpoint to avoid hammering the live DB and to attach retention policies.
alex: Agree. Also keep a small live tailing endpoint for live ops (/audit/stream) but rate-limited and only for high-priv roles.
maria: Another ask from compliance: preservation mode — once an export is kicked off for a window, we should freeze related snapshots for 7 years (or flag them immutable) so legal can reference exact state. Thoughts on storage cost? :dollar:
jin: We can tier: snapshots stored compressed + GPG, lifecycle to archive after 90 days to glacier. But searchable indexes (for quick queries) will only keep metadata.
sam: UX: when viewing a policy timeline, show inline diffs and allow "export this timeline" button. On export modal, show estimated size and retention implication.
alex: One more internal API debate: do we dedupe events by actor/transaction id at export time? i.e., many micro-updates during a rollout could flood the export. We should collapse consecutive updates with same actor/transaction into a single consolidated patch with an aggregation field `consolidated_count`.
jin: I like consolidation but keep raw events in the immutable store. Export can default to consolidated=true and allow raw=true.
maria: Checklist for next week: (1) finalize ndjson schema and redaction fields, (2) /audit/exports API spec + RBAC, (3) Console export UX wireframes + estimated bytes, (4) snapshot lifecycle + S3 bucket policy for preservation. I'll open GH issues.
devex-bot: created issue #4123: "audit exports: schema + export API + console UX" assigned to @maria @jin due 2026-06-01 :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks — let's sync Friday for a short walk-through.
